# RFC 6750 - The OAuth 2.0 Authorization Framework: Bearer Token Usage

Hardt ISSN: 2070-1721 Independent October 2012 The OAuth 2. 0 Authorization Framework: Bearer Token Usage Abstract This specification describes how to use bearer tokens in HTTP requests to access OAuth 2. Any party in possession of a bearer token (a "bearer") can use it to get access to the associated resources (without demonstrating possession of a cryptographic key). To prevent misuse, bearer tokens need to be protected from disclosure in storage and in transport. Copyright Notice Copyright (c) 2012 IETF Trust and the persons identified as the document authors.
